checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-status.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" status --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao status [flags]' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'durable AgentOps loop evidence' "$tmp/help" || grep -Fiq 'loop evidence' "$tmp/help"; work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-status-run.XXXXXX); ( cd "$work"; "$tmp/ao" status >"$tmp/human"; grep -Fq 'AgentOps Status' "$tmp/human"; grep -Fq 'Loop Evidence' "$tmp/human"; grep -Fq 'no_evidence' "$tmp/human"; "$tmp/ao" status --json >"$tmp/json"; grep -Fq '"loop_evidence"' "$tmp/json"; grep -Fq '"state": "no_evidence"' "$tmp/json" )

aliases.reason: The status family declares no command aliases.

rejected_args.reason: status accepts arbitrary positional args and rejects none.

stderr.reason: status emits its report on stdout only.

tracker_selection.reason: The status family does not select a repository issue tracker.
